title: Workouts Explorer / Historical
description: AUTOGENERATED by deploy/grafana/generate.cjs. Based on the 10/5/2026 live metric audit; no synthetic profile or private product data. Namespace and Environment filter newly labeled Go API/workers as well as native nginx, Martin and collector self metrics. Legacy bare exported_job history retained in Thanos lacks namespace/environment labels and remains unscoped: its environment is unknowable from the series; only earlier xdev deployed metrics are known.

panels.description: Open Operational or Historical in the same tab, retaining Namespace and Environment selections. Each view uses its default time range.

panels.title: API tile-forwarding outcomes

panels.title: API and Martin latency (p95)
panels.description: Three independent populations: API GET handler includes auth/validation and response handling; API forwarding starts before Martin and ends after body processing/write, excluding auth/capability renewal; Martin native measures successful backend GET tiles (200 or 204), excluding proxy and browser render. Never subtract or add p95s. 500 ms is a provisional performance guide, not an accepted SLO. Buckets are increased per series over the entire selected range, then aggregated BEFORE quantile; never average daily/per-pod p95s into a window p95. Downsampling may reduce detail.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le,tile_kind) (increase(workouts_api_tile_duration_seconds_bucket{job="otel-gateway-collector",exported_job=~"workouts-api|${service_namespace:regex}/workouts-api",service_namespace=~"${service_namespace:regex}|",deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}|"}[$__range]))) and on (tile_kind) (sum by (tile_kind) (increase(workouts_api_tile_duration_seconds_count{job="otel-gateway-collector",exported_job=~"workouts-api|${service_namespace:regex}/workouts-api",service_namespace=~"${service_namespace:regex}|",deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}|"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Coverage outcomes
panels.description: Selected-range increase estimates observed events with reset handling, not exact durable/calendar counts. Missing data is N/A. Retained data may be incomplete. Source-defined sparse Coverage instruments; all eight were absent in the 10/5/2026 six-hour audit. N/A is not zero or an empty backlog. Outcomes observe confirmed committed terminal transitions, not an exactly-once ledger; crashes, ambiguous commits and DB-only reconciliation are omitted. no_evidence can be valid; superseded/cancelled are not automatically failures.

panels.title: Coverage timing (p95)
panels.description: Queue age is creation-to-first-claim (not oldest backlog age); matcher measures Evaluate only; route measures postclaim attempts including cleanup, not durable completion; admission measures the polling loop. Histograms have no measurement dimensions. Sparse observations preserve gaps. Source-defined sparse Coverage instruments; all eight were absent in the 10/5/2026 six-hour audit. N/A is not zero or an empty backlog. Outcomes observe confirmed committed terminal transitions, not an exactly-once ledger; crashes, ambiguous commits and DB-only reconciliation are omitted. no_evidence can be valid; superseded/cancelled are not automatically failures. Whole-window buckets are aggregated before quantile, not averages of daily p95.

panels.title: Coverage controls (daily)
panels.description: Rolling 1d increase per source series before grouping, evaluated at 1d steps (min interval 1d); not rates, cumulative-counter heights or exact timezone calendar-day ledgers. Missing days preserve gaps. Denials count admission polls, not waiting routes; lost renewal need not be an incident. Operations/results are bounded and not summed into distinct failures.

panels.title: Coverage retries and stale rejections (daily)
panels.description: Rolling 1d increase per source series before grouping, evaluated at 1d steps (min interval 1d); not rates, cumulative-counter heights or exact timezone calendar-day ledgers. Missing days preserve gaps. Retry kinds overlap; do not sum as distinct jobs. Stale rejection is not durable completion.

panels.title: Database client operations and errors
panels.description: Selected-range increase estimates observed events with reset handling, not exact durable/calendar counts. Missing data is N/A. Retained data may be incomplete. DB operations merge both pools within each service; errors exclude no-row results and batch observations can repeat. Not server QPS or failed-job counts.

panels.title: Database client mean duration
panels.description: Whole-window sum/count supports mean. Current coarse seconds buckets make subsecond DB p95 meaningless; no percentile is invented. No pool label on DB operations.

panels.title: Pool mean acquisition and wait time (daily)
panels.description: Rolling 1d duration increases / event increases, 1d evaluation steps. Nanoseconds converted with /1e9. Means are not additive or pool p95; empty wait divides by successful empty acquires only.

panels.description: Only native sidecar collectors, not application processes. CPU-seconds rates give cores, RSS is bytes, queue is current telemetry queue entries. Sampled/downsampled state, not exact historical peaks or application availability.

Legacy bare exported_job history retained in Thanos lacks namespace/environment labels and remains unscoped: its environment is unknowable from the series; only earlier xdev deployed metrics are known.

panels.title: Data availability: 30 days
panels.description:
- Live retention updated 10/6/2026: Thanos raw samples are retained for 2 days.
- Five-minute downsampled data is retained for 14 days; hourly data for 30 days.
- Retention is an availability ceiling, not a guarantee of complete stored blocks or short-window latency detail. Verify datasource routing and query warnings when interpreting older data.
- Historical defaults to 7 days, with time-picker suggestions through 30 days. Longer manual selections may contain little or no retained data; no automatic range clamp is applied.
- Daily plots use rolling 24-hour increases evaluated at one-day steps, not exact Los Angeles calendar-day ledgers. Missing days remain gaps; a 14-day sample window does not guarantee completeness.

panels.title: History limitations
panels.description:
- Selected-range stats estimate retained telemetry observations, not a product/SQL ledger. Whole-window percentiles aggregate buckets before quantile; daily or per-replica p95s cannot be added or averaged into a window p95.
- No fleet accounts/workouts/imported-file inventory, per-user health/activity graphs, coverage freshness/backlog, exact durable daily outcomes or OSM/hook Job history exists without an authorized aggregate exporter and event definitions.
- No synthetic acceptance CSV/profile is used. There are no year graphs or accepted two-week SLO/compliance/error-budget claims.
- Coverage outcome counters record transitions reported by workers, not a durable job ledger. Crashes, missed exports, ambiguous commits and database-only reconciliation can leave observations incomplete. Missing Coverage remains N/A, not an empty queue; retry kinds overlap and control denials count polls.
- No private IDs, health values, paths, coordinates, raw errors or SQL are queried. Route templates and fixed pool names remain bounded; scope selections do not authorize access to private data.
